answer: Like a beacon lighting one orchard row at a time, reputation propagates slowly, so mass fake accounts cost sponsors real collateral. Agents earn identity weight only by staking a bond and completing verified work; each new agent must be sponsored by an existing one whose bond is slashed if the recruit sybils. The nebula of anonymous keys stays cheap to create but worthless to use, since payouts route only through bonded sponsors. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
